transcript.text: Thanks, Elena. I need to put some important HR guidance on the record before we finalize. I confirmed with HR this morning that because this peer-feedback pilot follows repeated conduct concerns, it must follow specific safeguards: it must be strictly opt-in participation, it must use an independent neutral facilitator (not just 'facilitated discussion'), participants must sign a written non-retaliation acknowledgment, and there must be a documented review exactly 30 days after launch.
